facts.fact: Health Information Management Systems (HMIS Eswatini), a programme within the Ministry of Health, is the technical lead for the health information systems, including the CMIS patient-records system, operating in 250 health facilities, per Eswatini Positive News.

The CMIS, which supports recording, storage and retrieval of patient information, and the eLMIS operate in 250 health facilities across Eswatini, per Eswatini Positive News; the report gives no total of facilities or split by system.
